agentFactory.mainChat.statusItems.descri: Choose which information to display and its order in the status bar settings below the chat. Drag items or use the move buttons to reorder them. An empty array hides all items.
agentFactory.mainChat.pythonPath.descrip: Python 3.10+ executable path on the extension host (without shell arguments). Empty uses python3 from PATH (python on Windows). On macOS, select your installed Python if the system Python is older.
agentFactory.mainChat.codexPath.descript: Optional absolute Codex CLI executable path on this extension host (without shell arguments). Empty or unusable values fall back to finding the `codex` command like a new terminal would (PATH, login-shell or registry PATH, nvm/fnm and common install locations).
agentFactory.mainChat.runtimeExecPath.de: Optional exec.py override for the Extension Development Host only. Normal windows always use the installed plugin cache. The F5 local plugin root takes precedence.
agentFactory.mainChat.executionMode.desc: Permissions for the next Main Agent run. The default allows full file system and network access without additional execution approval. You can restrict access to workspace writes or CLI defaults. Permissions can change between runs in the same session; the current run is unaffected.
agentFactory.mainChat.executionMode.enum: New sessions use CLI settings; existing sessions keep their saved policy.
Allow workspace writes without requesting additional approval during execution.
Allow full file system and network access without requesting additional approval during execution.
Allow full access and proceed without execution approval or plan reapproval.

agentFactory.mainChat.botsEnabled.descri: Enable companion bots in all chats, including animations and AI expressions.
agentFactory.mainChat.antigravityPath.de: Optional absolute path to the Antigravity CLI (`agy`) on this extension host. Empty or unusable values fall back to finding the `agy` command like a new terminal would. Antigravity models appear only when the CLI is found.
agentFactory.mainChat.claudePath.descrip: Optional absolute path to the Claude Code CLI on this extension host. Empty or unusable values fall back to finding the `claude` command like a new terminal would. Claude models appear only when the CLI is found.
agentFactory.mainChat.pluginUpdateMode.d: How the Agent Factory plugin bundled in each detected CLI (Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity) is kept in sync with this extension's version.
agentFactory.mainChat.developmentPluginR: Local Agent Factory plugin source directory for an Extension Development Host. Overrides the F5 launch path; empty uses that path. Plugin version differences do not block startup.
agentFactory.mainChat.pluginUpdateMode.e: Install or update the plugin automatically whenever a CLI is newly detected or its path changes.
Only install or update the plugin when you click "Update now" in Settings › General.
